30A pet friendly beach house rental, 30A Wonderland at Treetop, located in Seacrest Beach, FL is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home. This home is within the 30A gated community of Treetop Village. 4 bikes included with your stay.


This beautifully appointed home is located in the gated community of Treetop, just a short walk or bike ride to world-class beaches, restaurants, parks, and shops in Inlet Beach, Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach.


This home features gorgeous furnishings throughout with detailed woodwork, shiplap, hardwood floors, quartz counters, 2 master suites, spacious covered decks and lush landscaping offering additional privacy for guests. Guests also love the outdoor fire pit, foosball table, and cornhole game during their stay.


Free Activities Included. see details below***


FEATURES
* 5 Bedrooms, 4.5 Bathroom
* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bath - 1st Floor
* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - 2nd Floor
* Bedroom 3 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - 2nd Floor
* Bedroom 4 - 2 Bunk Beds - 2 Full over Full - 2nd Floor
* Bathroom 4 - Tub/Shower Combo
* Bedroom 5 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - 3rd Floor
* Living Area - Large Smart TV
* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar
* Dining Area 
* Living Area - 2 Queen and 1 Twin Sleeper Sofas
* Half Bathroom on Main Level
* Covered Decks
* Foosball Table - Second Balcony
* Back Patio with Seating and Gas Grill
* Outdoor Shower
* Screened in Deck - TV, Games, Seating
* Indoor Gas Fireplace
* Outdoor Fire Pit - Side Balcony
* Childrens Play Area
* Games - Books, Legos, Uno, Mancala, Trivial Pursuit.
* 4 Parking Spaces Only - Strictly Enforced
* FREE High Speed WI-FI
* Sleeps 21



ABOUT TREETOP VILLAGE IN SEACREST, FL 
This gated Seacrest community is nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach offering a prime 30A location. The community includes easy access with 2 private entrances off 30A and Hwy 98. Guests will enjoy being within walking distance to all the shops and restaurants at Seacrest, Alys and Rosemary Beach.


COMMUNITY AMENITIES
POOL
WALK TO RESTAURANTS AND SHOPS


BONUS ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY:

* 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round
* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round
* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct)


PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS
We welcome well-trained dogs to stay in this home. If traveling with a pet, please note that a non-refundable pet fee will be added after booking. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00.


INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL
Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.author: Angela B.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response:
Thank you for the review, Angela! We're delighted to hear that you and your family had a wonderful Rosemary Beach vacation at our beautiful home. It's great to know that you enjoyed the neighborhood and the convenience of biking to Rosemary or Seacrest, as well as the fun tram rides to the beach.

We appreciate your positive feedback on the comfortable bedrooms, well-stocked kitchen and bathrooms, and our prompt assistance with any issues or questions. While we're sorry to hear about the bugs on the screened porch and the unexpected bear visit, we're glad it didn't detract from your overall experience.

We also appreciate your understanding of the neighborhood rules and are thrilled to hear that it was one of the best family vacations you've had. We look forward to hosting you and your family again in this fun and beautiful area!

reviews.text:
This was a beautiful home in a beautiful neighborhood. We were a bike ride away from Rosemary or Seacrest area. We hopped on the neighborhood tram a few times to the beach which was always fun. The Treetop neighborhood had a lovely shaded pool that we frequently visited. The home was lovely with comfortable bedrooms. The kitchen and bathrooms were stocked with the basics. 
The management company quickly addressed any issues that arose or questions that we had. 
We did have some kind of big bugs that I avoided on our screened porch nightly. The screened porch was gorgeous and the family used it daily bugs and all. We did have a bear visit on our last evening! He seemed to be just as afraid of us and our dogs. I guess they are frequently spotted in the area searching for garbage. 
There are lots of rules in this neighborhood but easy to work around ( no beach towels are allowed to hang outside on the railings or $100 daily fine). I would definitely go back despite the rules and the bear! It was one of the best family vacations that we have had. Fun fun area and so beautiful!
